memory_candidates.content: Authoring a lean4 plan's `## Lean Challenge Statements` block for lean-challenge-snapshot.sh: the tool (1) counts every top-level theorem|lemma|def|instance-with-a-name as a Goals identifier and forces its body to sorry, (2) does NOT match `abbrev` or anonymous `instance`, so those keep their bodies and are not Goals, but (3) rewrites each matched declaration's chunk up to the NEXT matched declaration, so any abbrev/instance placed between two theorems is swallowed into the preceding `:= sorry`, and (4) its identifier regex is ASCII-only, so Unicode names (φ, w₁) escape or truncate. Recipe: put every supporting definition first as abbrev (sorry-bodied abbrevs for supporting proofs the probe will prove), then the Goal theorems; use ASCII identifiers; keep `**Goals**:` as the exact heading line with no other backticked ASCII identifiers in its bullets; assemble with `--dry-run` and compile the assembled module through `lake-build-guard.sh build --no-share -- env lean FILE` (plain `build` may replay a stale result for a rewritten file at the same path).
